Margin improvement for manufacturers

Most mid-market manufacturers carry products that lose money on every unit and do not know which. We rebuild product-line profitability from actual routings and actual purchase prices, renegotiate the ten largest spend categories, and take scrap and rework out of the two worst lines.

What you get

  • Profit by product line and by customer, from real data.
  • Procurement savings booked in the first quarter.
  • A pricing and mix plan the sales team has signed.
